read.thesis: Verizon's Q3 wireless and broadband reads as demand-led but promo-cut: postpaid phone adds 406k with promotional acquisition cost down 41% and capex held at $16.0–16.5B, so supply discipline is clear and the story is pricing and margin, not capacity.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures: $16.0 billion to $16.5 billion, inclusive of success-based investments for AI Connect.

triggers.label: Postpaid phone net adds guide raised
triggers.quote: Postpaid phone net additions: 1.1 million to 1.2 million, up from upper half of 750,000 to 1.0 million

triggers.label: Promo acquisition cost down 41%
triggers.quote: Promotional cost of acquisition decreased 41 percent year-over-year

triggers.label: FCF growth guide raised to ~12%
triggers.quote: Free cash flow: expected to approach 12.0 percent growth year-over-year, up from 9.0 to 10.0 percent.

guidance.quote: Postpaid phone net additions: 1.1 million to 1.2 million, up from upper half of 750,000 to 1.0 million
Adjusted EPS¹: $5.04 to $5.06, or 7.0 to 7.5 percent growth year-over-year, up from 6.0 to 7.0 percent.
